```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(lmerTest)
```

load in dataframe
```{r}
crypt_sv_df<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_structural_variant.csv')
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
```

# construct a summary of the sv across the crypts
determine number of crypts harbouring a structural variant:
```{r}
print(paste0('Crypts with structural variant :',length(unique(crypt_sv_df$crypt))))
```

```{r}
unique_svs<-nrow(unique(subset(crypt_sv_df, select = -crypt)))
print(paste0('Unique structural variants :',unique_svs))
```
state the number of unique structural variants by type 
```{r}
crypt_sv_df%>%
  select(-crypt)%>%
  unique()%>%
  count(type) 
```

```{r}
PD65118_SVs=nrow(unique(subset(crypt_sv_df[crypt_sv_df$patient=='PD65118',],select=-crypt)))
print(paste0('SVs for PD65118: ',PD65118_SVs))
```
## ii : assess for enrichment amongst colibactin positive cases :
```{r}
## create a per patient summary of unique svs:
patient_sv_summary<-crypt_sv_df%>%
  select(-crypt)%>%
  unique()%>%
  count(patient,name='unique_svs')

## annotate patients are colibactin positive or not :
patient_crypts_cut<-crypt_signature_attributions%>%
  group_by(patient)%>%
  summarise(patient_colibactin_pos=sum(SBS88>0 & ID18>0)>1,
            crypts_cut=n())

## load in metadata for each patient :
sv_crypt_metadata<-unique(subset(crypt_metadata,select=-c(biopsy, location, site))) # this is stored as per biopsy so need to subset
  
## create a dataframe
patient_sv_summary<-left_join(patient_sv_summary,sv_crypt_metadata,by=c('patient'='patient'))
patient_sv_summary<-left_join(patient_sv_summary,patient_crypts_cut,by=c('patient'='patient'))
```

perform linear modelling of association between number of svs and patient colibactin status
```{r}
assess_colibactin_enrichment<-lm(unique_svs~patient_colibactin_pos+age+crypts_cut,data=patient_sv_summary)
```

create a summary :
```{r}
conf_int<-as.data.frame(confint(assess_colibactin_enrichment))%>%
  select(lower_ci=`2.5 %`,
         upper_ci=`97.5 %`)

coeff=round(summary(assess_colibactin_enrichment)$coefficients['patient_colibactin_posTRUE','Estimate'],digits=1)
lower_ci=round(conf_int['patient_colibactin_posTRUE',]$lower_ci,digits=1)
upper_ci=round(conf_int['patient_colibactin_posTRUE',]$upper_ci,digits=1)

print(paste0(coeff, ' [',lower_ci,', ',upper_ci,'] p-value=', pvalue))
```
